changelog: Fixes the sliding dock overlapping the page indicator, and the page indicator disappearing when leaving the app drawer submenu. Pinning a shortcut now asks for confirmation before placing it, and shortcut icon corners match app icons. Fixes shortcuts that could not be added again after deletion, and shortcuts that stopped opening after the launcher was reopened.
changelogZh: 修复滑动停靠栏与页面指示器重叠，以及从抽屉二级菜单返回时指示器消失的问题。添加到桌面的快捷方式会先确认再放置，图标圆角与应用图标一致。修复快捷方式删除后无法再次添加，以及重新打开后打不开的问题。
